name: Tougou Maki
source:
She is full of curiousity, and is not shy of strangers; a very energetic and honest girl who gets along with anyone. She is currently learning housework so she can help her father.

Maki is also gutsy, like her father, [spoiler]and gets along with his girlfriends. She likes them because they are all nice people.[/spoiler]

"It's awwight, daddy's a free man!" 

[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Tougou_Maki]Alicesoftwiki's review[/url].]
